title: US Loses 81 Aircraft and Drones Worth $3.3 Billion in Iran War
detail: An analysis report tallies US losses to date in the Iran war at 81 aircraft, drones, and helicopters valued at approximately $3.3 billion. The figures underscore the sustained attrition of US airpower operating in a contested, high-density air-defense environment over the course of the conflict.

title: IRGC Threatens to Target US Bases and Naval Vessels If Ground Invasion Begins
detail: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) issued a direct warning that US military bases and naval vessels in the region will be targeted should a ground invasion of Iran commence. The threat signals a significant escalation threshold and is aimed at deterring any transition from air operations to ground engagement.
